senses.gloss: m. (late b. h.;, with format. ר) manager, treasurer.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 21:8">Ex. R. s. 21</cite> <he>עשיתיך ג׳ עליו</he> I have appointed thee its (the Sea’s) commander.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 51:2">Ex. R. s. 51</cite> <he>ג׳ לעצמו</he> sole treasurer.
Tosef. Hor. II, 10 אמרכל קודם לגי׳ the Amarkhal in the Temple is of a higher rank than the Gizbar; Y. ib. III, 48ᵇ ליגבר (corr. acc.); a. fr.—Pl. גִּזְבָּרִים, גִּזְבָּרִין, גִּיזְ׳.
<cite ref="Shabbat 62a:15">Sabb. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>אשה ג׳</he> a woman engaged as treasurer (wearing a signet ring).
